method: A source-backed baseline was prepared from official vendor pages on 30 July 2026 and is awaiting one-time human approval. Ambiguous vendor pricing remains explicitly unverified. No automated refresh has completed successfully.

attributes.label: Price
attributes.description: The amount and currency billed to a Canadian customer. No currency conversion.

attributes.label: Can act on email
attributes.description: Label, archive, move, draft or send.

attributes.label: Unattended execution
attributes.description: Scheduled or event-driven work without a live chat.

attributes.label: Business data used for training
attributes.description: Default use of customer content for model training.

evidence.label: Monthly amount
evidence.quote: *2+ users, billed annually. CA$34 per user per month when billed monthly.

cells.display: CAD 27/user/month with annual billing; CAD 34 with monthly billing
cells.note: The live Canadian pricing page now says CA$34 monthly, but an earlier view of the same page showed an unlabelled $25.00 monthly footnote. The current CAD figures are defensible; the prior contradiction remains unresolved until checkout.

cells.display: 2 standard ChatGPT seats
cells.note: The two-seat minimum applies to standard ChatGPT seats. Legacy Codex-only Business configurations are a separate exception and do not provide ChatGPT access.

cells.display: None; purchased directly as a self-serve Business workspace
cells.note: No other paid OpenAI subscription is required. A ChatGPT account and a minimum purchase of two standard seats are required.

cells.display: Gmail and Outlook
cells.note: Both require the corresponding connected app and may depend on workspace and administrator settings.

cells.display: Drafts and sends Gmail or Outlook email with user confirmation. Outlook shared mailboxes also support mark and move actions.
cells.note: ChatGPT creates a draft and the user chooses whether to send it. Shared or delegated Outlook actions depend on Microsoft permissions and workspace settings.

cells.display: Yes, scheduled tasks. Maximum once per hour.
cells.note: Tasks cannot run more than once per hour and the number of active tasks is capped per plan.

cells.display: No, by default
cells.note: Stated as no training on your business data by default.

evidence.label: Annual and monthly amounts
evidence.quote: $28 Per seat / month if billed annually. $35 if billed monthly.

cells.display: $28/seat/month with annual billing; $35 monthly. Currency not stated.
cells.note: Claude's live page displays $28 and $35 without a currency code or region selector. Its help centre says pricing and currency vary by region and labels $20/$25 as U.S. pricing, so assigning CAD or USD to the live figures would be a guess.

cells.display: 2 users
cells.note: Stated as for teams of 2 to 150.

cells.display: None; create Team directly with a business email
cells.note: No Pro or Max subscription is required. The creator must use a business email, and members must use an allowed organization domain.

cells.display: Gmail and Outlook
cells.note: Gmail uses the Google connector. Outlook requires a work Microsoft 365 account tied to an Entra tenant. Team owners or administrators must enable the connectors.

cells.display: Gmail: drafts and organizes, but cannot send. Outlook: drafts, sends and organizes when administrator-enabled.
cells.note: Gmail actions require explicit approval and sending remains manual. Microsoft 365 write tools can send and organize Outlook mail when an administrator enables them; attachments are not supported in write actions.

cells.display: Yes. Runs remotely on a schedule even with the computer asleep.
cells.note: Scheduled tasks in Cowork, available on all paid plans. Hourly, daily, weekly or weekdays.

cells.display: No, by default
cells.note: Team is a commercial Claude for Work offering. Chats and coding sessions are not used for training unless the organization explicitly participates or submits opted-in content.

evidence.label: Annual list and promotional amounts
evidence.quote: Discount details Aug 12, 2026 – Nov 12, 2026 $9.20 CAD $18.40 (50% off) per user / month for all users Starting Nov 12, 2026 $18.40 CAD per user / month for all users

evidence.label: Monthly list and promotional amounts
evidence.quote: Discount details Aug 12, 2026 – Nov 12, 2026 $11.00 CAD $22.00 (50% off) per user / month for all users Starting Nov 12, 2026 $22.00 CAD per user / month for all users

evidence.label: Promotion duration shown on the card
evidence.quote: 50% off your first 3 months of Google Workspace. Offer valid for a limited time. Discount applied at checkout.

evidence.label: Contradictory promotion footnote
evidence.quote: This introductory price is only available for the first 20 users added, for 12 months.

cells.display: CAD 18.40 annual list (CAD 9.20 promo); CAD 22 monthly list (CAD 11 promo). Promo shown for 12 August–12 November 2026.
cells.note: The Canada page states all prices are CAD. Its price card and dated details say 50% off for three months, but the linked ** footnote says the introductory price lasts 12 months for the first 20 users. The amounts and dated promotion window are explicit; the duration terms conflict.

cells.display: 1 user
cells.note: Google identifies Business Standard as supporting organizations with 1 to 300 users.

cells.display: Google Workspace Business Standard; Gemini included, with no separate add-on
cells.note: The compared price is the Workspace Business Standard subscription itself. Google discontinued separate Gemini Business add-on packaging.

cells.display: Gmail
cells.note: Gemini is embedded in Gmail. Access depends on the Workspace edition and administrator configuration; no native Outlook mailbox access is documented.

cells.display: Summarises, suggests replies and drafts emails. The user sends and files.
cells.note: Embedded Gemini in Gmail can generate drafts. The standalone Gemini app's Gmail Connected App cannot create drafts or delete email. Neither source documents autonomous sending, labelling, archiving or moving.

cells.display: Yes—up to 10 scheduled actions
cells.note: Business Standard qualifies for scheduled actions. Keep Activity must be enabled, and the administrator controls availability. This is scheduled execution, not arbitrary event-driven automation.

cells.display: No, unless the customer grants permission
cells.note: This applies to Business Standard's core-service, enterprise-protected Gemini use. Google expressly retains a permission qualifier.

promotion.description: Annual price for the first year

evidence.label: Annual list and promotional amounts
evidence.quote: Originally starting from CAD $28.50 now starting from CAD $24.43 user/month, paid yearly (Annual subscription—auto renews)

evidence.label: Promotion dates
evidence.quote: This discount offer is available between July 1, 2026, and September 30, 2026. An annual commitment is required, and promotional pricing applies to the first year only.

cells.display: CAD 28.50 annual list (CAD 24.43 promo); CAD 34.20 monthly. Promo ends 30 September 2026.
cells.note: The promotional amount applies only to an annual commitment for the first year. A qualifying Microsoft 365 Business plan is also required.

cells.display: 1 user
cells.note: Microsoft states no licence minimum and a range of 1 to 300 licences for standalone Copilot Business.

cells.display: A qualifying Microsoft 365 Business plan
cells.note: Stated as a Microsoft 365 Business plan is required to purchase Microsoft 365 Copilot Business. The bundled SKUs include it.

cells.display: Outlook
cells.note: Microsoft documents Copilot grounded in Outlook data and embedded in Outlook. No native Gmail mailbox access is documented.

cells.display: Pins, flags, archives, deletes and marks email read or unread; drafts and prioritises.
cells.note: Actions work on individual or multiple messages and update Outlook. Larger bulk actions can require confirmation. Email triage is currently documented as English-only; sending remains user-initiated.

cells.display: Yes—up to 10 scheduled prompts
cells.note: Requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. Scheduled prompts can run through Copilot Chat, Teams or Outlook; administrators can disable Optional Connected Experiences.

cells.display: No
cells.note: Under enterprise data protection, prompts, responses and Microsoft Graph-grounded organizational data are excluded from foundation-model training.

evidence.label: Billing currency
evidence.quote: Purchases for API credits are currently limited to USD.

cells.display: Usage-based: USD 5 input and USD 30 output per 1M tokens. No annual or monthly subscription.
cells.note: This is the model API charge only, not a fixed implementation cost. Hosting, integration and operating costs are separate.

cells.display: No seat minimum
cells.note: The model API is usage-based rather than licensed per person. Implementation, hosting and mailbox-provider costs remain separate.

cells.display: API billing, hosting, OAuth and implementation work
cells.note: This is an architecture, not a packaged subscription. It needs an API project and billing plus a hosted application, mailbox OAuth permissions and operating controls.

cells.display: Gmail and Outlook, when integrated
cells.note: Gmail access is provided by the Gmail API and Outlook access by Microsoft Graph. Each requires its own application registration, OAuth scopes and administrator consent policy.

cells.display: Configurable: label, archive, move, draft or send with chosen scopes and approvals
cells.note: Both mailbox APIs document read, draft, send and organization actions. The implemented scopes, approval gates and safety rules determine what a custom application can actually do.

cells.display: Yes, if built with a scheduler or mailbox change notifications
cells.note: Gmail and Microsoft Graph provide mailbox change notifications, but the custom application must supply the scheduler or webhook service, retries, approvals and monitoring.

cells.display: No, by default
cells.note: OpenAI states that API inputs and outputs are not used to train models by default unless the customer explicitly opts in. Default abuse-monitoring retention still applies.
